set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-film.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Build checked FilmCompilerInput associations, exact support containment and chart/provenance selection, with swapped/foreign/gap controls. This is input assembly, not emitted film compilation. Use the preserved September film phase plan and qualify the exact downstream consumer; no scientific accuracy follows.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Checked FilmCompilerInput joins one composed AnchoredNarrativeAtlas, BoundProposalSurface, exact ordered source records and a sentence-unit-to-origin table; missing/duplicate/foreign/swapped associations refuse.
2. Multi-sentence descriptions create distinct associated sentence units with inherited physical envelopes; original row/scene units remain separately addressable. Recipe/separators/sentence boundaries and complete table participate in identity.
3. MediaTime/MediaPoint support checks full bundle binding and every stream/axis, and is contained in the complete same-stream/unit interval union plus points; unsupported anchor kinds refuse explicitly.
4. Wrong native unit with matching primary support, real gaps, excluded ends, point-versus-interval containment and partial coverage have isolated refusals plus lawful mixed-support controls; no hull or implicit coordinate conversion.
5. Two independently parsed descriptions bind each chart and relevant parse/derivation calls to its sentence unit. The input provenance-selection helper returns A-only calls for A references, both for combined references, and preserves shared upstream calls; swapped or foreign joins refuse. Emitted-claim inclusion/exclusion is an F5 court, outside this input-only child.
6. Model canonical-form guards still reject proposal-surface text as film physical support. Changing source bytes, unit structure, expected receipt or origin changes identity or refuses.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- Input assembly only; no status choice, full compiler result, actual media acquisition or scientific inference.

Plan sections: §1, §4, §5.
